summary: U Power Limited, a Cayman Islands foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K announcing a 20:1 share consolidation of its authorized, issued, and unissued ordinary shares. The board approved the consolidation on November 4, 2025, and shareholders approved it on December 5, 2025. Post-consolidation, authorized share capital is US$50,000 divided into 19,997,059.06 Class A and 5,002,940.94 Class B ordinary shares, each with US$0.002 par value. Trading on Nasdaq under symbol UCAR begins on a post-consolidation basis on September 9, 2026, with a new CUSIP. No fractional shares will be issued; fractional entitlements will be rounded up to whole shares, with no cash paid. This reverse stock split aims to meet listing requirements and is a structural capital adjustment.
